name: Greenhouse Kitchen + Bar

sources.notes: Official homepage confirms the active Vienna/Tysons restaurant identity, address, phone, hours, and menu links.
Current official ordering menu fully enumerates the location-specific dinner, sushi, kids, side, and dessert catalog with ingredient descriptions.
Current dedicated official sushi menu corroborates sushi products and includes Greenhouse Roll, which is not displayed on the ordering page.
Official site states that the restaurant regularly uses nuts and other major allergens and that cross-contact may occur.
Restaurant-linked Toast listing corroborates the rebranded Greenhouse Kitchen + Bar identity and location.
Official-document search found no exhaustive product-by-allergen matrix.
Targeted search corroborated the official allergen notice but found no exhaustive item matrix.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.claim: Greenhouse states that its kitchens regularly use nuts and other major allergens and that cross-contact may occur; this supports a positive tree-nut cross-contact warning but not allergen absence for any item.
No exhaustive current product-by-allergen matrix was found.

summary: Greenhouse Kitchen + Bar’s current Vienna ordering and sushi surfaces enumerate 99 distinct products. Of 91 frozen rows, 87 match exactly, 3 normalize for current spelling, and 1 are stale. The restaurant publishes a nut and major-allergen cross-contact warning but no exhaustive product matrix.
